planSlice.remainder: AstronautForm (index.tsx) as the mounting host and FormWrapper drawer shell, AstronautSide's Configuration (Left/Right) radios, CanvasObjectAngleInput, the Distances/Coordinates sections (gated on properties.isPlaced), DoneButton and NavbarDeleteMapElement stay React in this slice; a later slice can migrate them once their shared prerequisites (canvas-object-angle-input, canvas-object-coordinates-details, map-object-distances, done-button, form-wrapper, navbar-delete-map-element, element-creation-manager, lely-red-rules for AstronautSide's LabelText import from chargerForm) are built.

scope.startState: An astronaut is selected in the Floor Plan Creator, so AstronautForm renders AstronautModel's Model section with the astronaut's current model selected (AstronautModel.tsx:100-124, index.tsx:34).
scope.endState: The edited Model (and, where applicable, Type) is applied to the selected astronaut's canvas object, a Move history entry is recorded, and the map editor can still use the retained Configuration, Angle, Distances/Coordinates, Done and Delete controls to finish editing (AstronautModel.tsx:19-25,28-34, index.tsx:30-45).

renderedSurfaceInventory.surface: Model (A5/A4/A3) and, where applicable, Type (I-Flow/J-flow/Jersey or Regular/Next) collapsible RadioButtonGroup sections (AstronautModel)
MapObjectDistances plus Coordinates Details, gated on properties.isPlaced

angularOwns: Type RadioButtonGroup, rendered only for an A5 or A3 model, bound to the same property (AstronautModel.tsx:37-96)
The Model and Type sections' own collapse/expand state (Details.isOpen), reset to expanded on every mount (AstronautModel.tsx:15-16)
reactRetains: index.tsx (AstronautForm) as the mounting host and FormWrapper drawer shell
Distances and Coordinates sections, gated on properties.isPlaced

inputs: model: Model | undefined (astronaut.properties.model, AstronautModel.tsx:14, Model enum in AstronautConfig.ts:26-33)
hasSelection: boolean (whether store.selectedObject exists at all, AstronautModel.tsx:38 and the optional-chained checks at AstronautModel.tsx:107,113,119)
adapter.nonSuccessOutcome: There is no invalid input to reject: every Model radio always supplies one of the enum's fixed values. Clicking the A5 or A3 group radio while a different subtype of that same group is already active always resets Type to the group's first option (A5IFlow or A3Regular) rather than keeping the previously selected subtype (AstronautModel.tsx:108,120); this is existing behavior to preserve, not an error case.
forbiddenAccess: DOM queries outside the mounted host node
Stores.* global state beyond the selected astronaut's model, passed in as the adapter input

FloorPlanMaker.history and ElementCreationManager.astronautCreator APIs directly from outside the migrated component; history recording stays behind the same FloorPlanMaker history bridge this flow builds, and placement/Done handling stays in the retained index.tsx (see decisions)

lifecycle: The Angular application is created with createApplication() and mounted with createComponent() from a React effect on a ref in AngularAstronautModelHost.tsx, per docs\project-constants.md#Embedding
The same React effect destroys the Angular application on unmount

The host effect re-supplies the model input and forces a resync whenever the selected astronaut's id changes, since CanvasObject identity is not itself an Angular input, matching the FormWrapper key remount at index.tsx:29 (which today resets AstronautModel's local isOpen state to expanded on every astronaut selection change)
Change detection is zoneless via provideExperimentalZonelessChangeDetection(), per docs\project-constants.md#Change-detection
styling: Templates are inline in @Component, never a separate .html file, per docs\project-constants.md#Compilation

The Model/Type Details header keeps the Summary caret-toggle layout and spacing (Details.tsx:55-63), and the CaretUp/CaretDown chevrons port as literal inline <svg> markup copied from @lely/icons (node_modules/@lely/icons/src/assets/caret-up.svg, caret-down.svg), never a bound [innerHTML], per docs\project-constants.md#Styling

RadioButtonGroup's bordered row (RadioButtonGroup.tsx:6-33) and RadioButton's row/label/circle/dot styling (RadioButton.tsx:28-54, RadioButtonBase.tsx:37-119) port declaration by declaration using design tokens (@lely/tokens/enums), not literal values
No additional padding is added on top of the existing FormWrapper vertical rhythm (FormWrapper.tsx referenced by the retained index.tsx:29)

dependencyChanges.note: These packages are already present in package.json at revision 03bb7e90a09b1e56b75801d03d7eb349828f0b59 (added by the first migrated slice); this flow needs no new dependency or config change.

scenarios.given: An astronaut is selected with any model other than an A5 variant.
scenarios.when: The map editor selects the A5 radio in the Model section.
then: astronaut.properties.model is set to A5IFlow, regardless of which A5 subtype (I-Flow/J-flow/Jersey) may have been active before.
A Move history entry is added for the astronaut (FloorPlanMaker.history.addCanvasObjectItem).

scenarios.given: An astronaut is selected with any model other than an A3 variant.
scenarios.when: The map editor selects the A3 radio in the Model section.
then: astronaut.properties.model is set to A3Regular, regardless of which A3 subtype (Regular/Next) may have been active before.
A Move history entry is added for the astronaut.

scenarios.when: The map editor selects the A4 radio in the Model section.
then: astronaut.properties.model is set to A4 and a Move history entry is added.
No Type section renders: showTypeOptions falls through both the A5 and A3 branches and returns null.

scenarios.given: An astronaut is selected with an A5 model (I-Flow, J-flow or Jersey), so the Type section shows I-Flow/J-flow/Jersey radios.
scenarios.when: The map editor selects a different Type radio.
then: astronaut.properties.model is set to the chosen A5 subtype (A5IFlow, A5JFlow or A5Jersey).
A Move history entry is added for the astronaut.

scenarios.given: An astronaut is selected with an A3 model (Regular or Next), so the Type section shows Regular/Next radios.
scenarios.when: The map editor selects a different Type radio.
then: astronaut.properties.model is set to the chosen A3 subtype (A3Regular or A3Next).
A Move history entry is added for the astronaut.

scenarios.given: No astronaut is currently selected (store.selectedObject is undefined).
then: No Model radio shows active (the optional-chained checks are all false).
The Type section renders nothing (showTypeOptions returns null on its own selectedObject guard).

scenarios.given: The Model or Type section has been collapsed for the currently selected astronaut.
scenarios.when: The map editor selects a different astronaut (or the same astronaut again after deselecting), remounting the form via its selectedObject-id key.
then: Both the Model and Type sections render expanded again, since modelOpen/typeOpen are local state initialized to true on every mount.

visualParity.surface: Model and Type collapsible sections in the astronautForm drawer
visualParity.counterpart: AstronautSide's retained Configuration RadioButtonGroup, the sibling immediately above Model in the same form, for the radio-button family's appearance; no other Details-wrapped section exists in this same form to compare the collapsible header chrome against, since Model/Type are this form's only Details usage (AstronautModel.tsx source is itself the authority for that chrome)
appearance: Collapsible header (Details' Summary) with the label left-aligned and the CaretUp/CaretDown chevron right-aligned, flipping between the two on toggle (Details.tsx:39-52).
Bordered fieldset row per radio group with the theme's neutral hover/active background (RadioButtonGroup.tsx:6-33).
Each radio shows a 24x24 circle-and-dot control left of its label, using theme border/background colors for default, hover, focus-visible and disabled states (RadioButtonBase.tsx:37-119).

layout: Section width matches the retained Configuration section directly above it and the parent FormWrapper's content width.
Column direction: radios stack vertically within each group, matching direction="column" (AstronautModel.tsx:47,76,105).
The migrated sections add no additional padding on top of the existing FormWrapper vertical rhythm.

Tab order continues from the retained Configuration/Angle fields: Model radios use tabIndex 2-4, Type radios reuse tabIndex 5-7 within whichever branch renders (AstronautModel.tsx:110,116,122,52,58,64,81,87).

characterizationRequired.hypothesis: Clicking the A5 (or A3) group radio always forces Type back to the group's first subtype (A5IFlow / A3Regular), even when a different subtype of that same group was already active; this must be reproduced exactly, since it looks like an easy 'fix' to instead keep the current subtype.

The Model/Type Details sections must re-expand on every remount (new astronaut selection) rather than remembering a collapsed state across selections, since useState(true) is re-initialized on each mount of AstronautModel.

decisions.topic: Slice boundary for the Detail Drawer AstronautForm flow
decisions.decision: Angular owns only AstronautModel (the Model and, where applicable, Type sections); index.tsx (as the mounting host and FormWrapper shell), AstronautSide's Configuration radios, the Angle field, the Distances/Coordinates sections, DoneButton and NavbarDeleteMapElement stay in React.
decisions.rationale: A whole-form swap was rejected: FormWrapper, DoneButton, CanvasObjectAngleInput, CanvasObjectCoordinatesDetails and MapObjectDistances are each shared by many other not-yet-migrated detail-drawer forms (matching the precedent set for detail-drawer-straight-strip-form), so pulling their Angular counterparts into this slice's write allowlist would violate one owner and no-shared-infrastructure and leave no retain-react sibling to compare against. AstronautSide was also excluded from the migrate scope, even though it is equally self-contained, because it imports LabelText from ../chargerForm/LabelText.tsx (chargerForm/LabelText.tsx:1-5) - a cross-folder React file the migration map's astronaut-form entry does not list as a prerequisite and that detail-drawer-charger-form and detail-drawer-dump-station-form also depend on (migration-map.json openQuestions). Migrating AstronautSide now would force a decision about LabelText's ownership that belongs to a slice that actually touches chargerForm; AstronautModel needs no such file. AstronautModel is also the largest cut that still satisfies boundedBranches on its own: its only conditional is showTypeOptions' three-way model-group switch, fully contained inside the file.
decisions.followUp: A later slice may migrate AstronautSide once the LabelText ownership question is resolved (ideally by the chargerForm/dumpStationForm slice that already flags it), and/or the Angle field, Distances/Coordinates sections, DoneButton and NavbarDeleteMapElement once every detail-drawer form that shares them has moved.

decisions.topic: Map correction: Icon is an undeclared transitive prerequisite of Details
decisions.decision: migration-map.json's requires list for detail-drawer-astronaut-form does not include "icon", but Details.tsx renders an Icon for its caret toggle (Details.tsx:44-46), confirmed by style-sources.mjs's sharedComponents output. This slice builds icon's Angular counterpart at its measured target (src/angular/shared/components/icons/icon.component.ts) alongside details, radio-button, radio-button-group, flex and text, all six also confirmed unbuilt (angular.status: "none") by the same trace.
decisions.rationale: AstronautModel cannot render its actual pixels without Angular-native versions of every shared UI atom Details/RadioButton/RadioButtonGroup compose (Details itself renders Flex, Icon and Text). Per docs\project-constants.md#Styling, the two caret icons port as literal inline <svg> markup copied from @lely/icons's raw source files (node_modules/@lely/icons/src/assets/caret-up.svg, caret-down.svg) rather than porting Icon.tsx's whole runtime icon registry.
decisions.followUp: Every later slice that needs details, radio-button, radio-button-group, flex, text or icon reuses these six Angular counterparts at their measured targets rather than rebuilding them.

decisions.topic: floor-plan-stores and the FloorPlanMaker history call (via element-creation-manager) are also being built by detail-drawer-straight-strip-form
decisions.decision: This flow builds Angular counterparts for floor-plan-stores (src/angular/core/store/floor-plan-stores.store.ts, its measured target) and the FloorPlanMaker.history.addCanvasObjectItem bridge inside element-creation-manager's measured target (src/angular/core/bridges/drawlib/floor-plan-maker/element-creation-manager), since migration-map.json lists element-creation-manager, not floor-plan-maker-facade, as this flow's prerequisite for that call. detail-drawer-straight-strip-form's in-flight baseline already claims the same two targets.
decisions.rationale: Per docs\project-constants.md#Branches-and-worktrees, two slices building the same unbuilt prerequisite in parallel worktrees is an accepted, already-documented risk (--ready's sharesUnbuiltWithActive) that only surfaces as a merge conflict for whichever slice lands second; it is not this baseline's job to resolve, only to flag it.
decisions.followUp: Whichever of detail-drawer-straight-strip-form or detail-drawer-astronaut-form lands first establishes the canonical floor-plan-stores.store.ts and history bridge; the second to land resolves the merge conflict by reusing the already-landed files instead of re-adding its own copy.

testGaps: astronautForm has no __tests__ folder today; neither AstronautModel.tsx's updateModel/updateModelType/showTypeOptions branching nor AstronautSide's/index.tsx's wiring has any automated test (confirmed by directory listing).

The existing undoRedo/__test__/index.test.ts and MapMakerManager.test.ts tests exercise Move-history recording and object selection generically across canvas object types (including Astronaut) but never through AstronautModel's own updateModel/updateModelType handlers, so they do not cover this flow's specific branching or the A5/A3 subtype-reset behavior.
Per-flow coverage for this folder was not retrieved this run; CI computes it via npm run test:ci and uploads coverage/lcov.info to the Lely-Route-Assistant-Frontend SonarQube project.

userStory.title: Migrate the Astronaut detail drawer's Model selection to Angular
userStory.userValue: As a map editor, I want to change a placed astronaut's model and type so that the map matches the physical robot installed in the barn.
userStory.currentBehavior: React's AstronautModel renders the Model (A5/A4/A3) section and, for an A5 or A3 model, a matching Type section, alongside the retained Configuration, Angle, Distances/Coordinates, Done and Delete controls.
userStory.desiredBehavior: Angular renders the Model and Type sections inside the retained React drawer with the same selection, history-recording and subtype-reset behavior, matching the retained Configuration section's radio-button appearance.

manualValidation.environment: Route Assistant desktop application running the local frontend and local backend, title bar showing 'localhost' and 'react mode: development' badges, per docs\project-constants.md#Manual-verification-environment.
manualValidation.userPath: Open the Floor Plan Creator and place (or select) an Astronaut object on the map; its detail drawer opens automatically (detailDrawer/index.tsx:200-203).
manualValidation.scenario: Select an existing astronaut (or place a new one) and change its Model between A5, A4 and A3: confirm the map astronaut's image updates for each model; for A5 and A3, expand the Type section and switch subtypes, confirming the correct subtype image and radio state; confirm switching from one group to another always lands on that group's first subtype; confirm collapsing then reselecting a different astronaut re-expands both sections; confirm the retained Configuration, Angle, Distances/Coordinates, Done button and Delete key beside it still behave and look the same; confirm undo/redo still restores each model/type change.

rollback: Revert only the files listed in scope.allowedWritePaths (astronautForm/AstronautModel.tsx, index.tsx, AngularAstronautModelHost.tsx, any additions under astronautForm/__tests__, the new astronaut-form Angular folder, the new shared/components details/radio-button/icons/flex/text files, and the new core/store and core/bridges/drawlib/floor-plan-maker/element-creation-manager files) to their state at revision 03bb7e90a09b1e56b75801d03d7eb349828f0b59. Do not revert any other detail-drawer form, AstronautSide.tsx, chargerForm/LabelText.tsx, CanvasObjectAngleInput.tsx, or NavbarDeleteMapElement.tsx, since this slice never touches them. No package.json changes are made, so no npm install is needed after reverting.
